provenance.note: Introspected from one live UE 5.8 unreal module on one machine, with that machine's plugin set enabled. A symbol absent here is absent from that build, not from Unreal; a project on another engine version or with different plugins enabled will disagree, and describe/dir() in a live interpreter is the authority when it does.

coverage.note: Two tiers. This file carries full method detail only for the symbols a shipped procedure reaches; the manifest carries every symbol name so a lookup that found nothing can say whether the name is unknown to this engine build or merely not indexed for any task class yet.
